categories.main_business_segments: Arrow Electronics operates two primary business segments: the Global Components segment, which markets and distributes electronic components to original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) and contract manufacturers (CMs), and the Global Enterprise Computing Solutions (ECS) segment, which provides enterprise computing solutions to value-added resellers (VARs) and managed service providers (MSPs). In 2022, approximately 78% of sales were from Global Components and 22% from Global ECS.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Arrow's core capabilities include the aggregation and distribution of electronic components (such as semiconductors, passive, electromechanical, and interconnect products), as well as IT hardware and software solutions. The company leverages value-added services like design engineering, integration, global logistics, supply chain management, and digital platforms (e.g., ArrowSphere for cloud solutions) to support customers' product development and IT deployments.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Arrow serves over 210,000 industrial and commercial customers worldwide, including OEMs, CMs, VARs, MSPs, and other commercial entities. Key end markets include industrial equipment, automotive and transportation, telecommunications, contract manufacturing, and consumer products, as well as IT infrastructure and cloud services.
categories.geographic_coverage: Arrow operates in more than 90 countries, with significant presence in the Americas, Europe/Middle East/Africa (EMEA), and Asia/Pacific regions. In 2022, 65% of sales were generated outside the United States, with major markets including the U.S., China/Hong Kong, and Germany.
categories.supply_chain_position: Arrow primarily operates as a distributor and value-added service provider in the midstream of the electronics and IT supply chain, bridging suppliers (component and IT manufacturers) and end customers (OEMs, CMs, VARs, MSPs). The company also offers upstream design and engineering support and downstream logistics and integration services.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Arrow's strategic priorities include expanding value-added demand creation services, enhancing global supply chain offerings (procurement, logistics, analytics), and enabling digital/cloud transformation for customers through platforms like ArrowSphere. The company pursues both organic growth and strategic acquisitions to broaden its product and service portfolio, increase market penetration, and expand geographic reach.
categories.revenue_model: Arrow generates revenue primarily through the sale and distribution of electronic components, IT hardware, and software products, as well as value-added services such as design, integration, logistics, and cloud marketplace solutions. Most sales are made on an order-by-order basis rather than long-term contracts, with some agency arrangements for service contracts and logistics.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Arrow competes with large multinational and national distributors such as Avnet, CDW, TD Synnex, and WESCO, as well as specialized regional players and, in some cases, directly with suppliers. The company is positioned as one of the world's largest and most comprehensive technology distributors, with broad product lines, global reach, and extensive value-added services.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Arrow reported consolidated sales of $37.1 billion, up 7.7% from the prior year, with net income attributable to shareholders of $1.43 billion. The company has demonstrated consistent growth in both revenue and profitability, with a global workforce of approximately 22,300 employees and significant investments in working capital and inventory to support supply chain resilience.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Arrow differentiates itself through its broad product portfolio, global distribution network, and comprehensive suite of value-added services, including design engineering, supply chain management, and digital/cloud enablement. The company emphasizes accelerating customers' time to market, enabling secure and consistent supply chains, and providing innovative solutions that enhance competitiveness for both customers and suppliers.
